name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Coordinated Russian intelligence operations conducting arson, maritime drone strikes, critical satellite communications sabotage, and high-level political targeting across Poland, the Baltics, and the Black Sea littoral.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actors weaponizing an unauthenticated three-vulnerability chain (including CVE-2026-104935) to secure remote root command execution on perimeter VPN appliances.

name: DPRK Remote Worker Infiltration (Operation Lonestar Roundup)
summary: State-sponsored identity theft and laptop farm rings placing DPRK software developers inside Western tech enterprises to funnel revenue and exfiltrate IP.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Systematic targeting of retail cold-chain refrigeration networks via default and predictable credential schemes in building management controllers.
